rulings.ruling: Ruling: project retained; the question is now split. Step 5, question 1 (the credit for other dependents) asks whether you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN or ITIN issued on or before the due date and adds '(Answer "Yes" if you are applying for an ITIN on or before the return due date (including extensions).)'
